audit.root_cause: The wheel ships only legalbench.py (`[tool.hatch.build] include = ["legalbench.py"]`), but that file imports the sibling modules evaluation, prompts and tasks, and reads prompt templates from a CWD-relative path `environments/legalbench/tasks/...`, so the installed package can't be imported.
audit.evidence: src/omkar334__legalbench/pyproject.toml:19-20 include only legalbench.py; legalbench.py:12-14 `from evaluation import ...`/`from prompts import ...`/`from tasks import TASKS`; legalbench.py:182 `open(f"environments/legalbench/tasks/{task_name}/{file}")`; result.json first_failure: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'evaluation'`. The reported ImportError comes from the harness auto-installing the unrelated PyPI package `evaluation==0.0.2` (logs/autofix.log).
audit.irl_fix: Turn the env into a package that includes evaluation.py, prompts.py and tasks/, use package-relative imports, and load templates via `Path(__file__).parent / 'tasks'`.
